description: Phase B: Core Features - Add essential geometry and transformation capabilities

userStories.title: Boolean Operations (Union, Difference, Intersection)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to perform boolean operations on solid objects.
acceptanceCriteria: Add boolean_operation tool accepting operation type, object IDs
Support UNION, DIFFERENCE, INTERSECTION operations
Handle errors gracefully (non-solid objects, disjoint geometry)
Return new object ID after operation
Add tests for each operation type
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10. Python tool + C# handler + 9 tests.

userStories.title: Transform Tools (Copy, Mirror, Array)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to copy, mirror, and array objects.
acceptanceCriteria: Add copy_object tool (single object duplication with optional transform)
Add mirror_object tool (mirror across plane)
Add array_linear tool (linear array with count and spacing)
Add array_polar tool (polar array around center point)
All tools return new object IDs
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10. 4 Python tools + C# handlers + 14 tests.

userStories.title: Curve Operations (Offset, Fillet, Chamfer)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to offset curves and add fillets/chamfers to corners.
acceptanceCriteria: Add offset_curve tool with distance parameter
Add fillet_curves tool with radius parameter
Add chamfer_curves tool with distance parameters
Handle open and closed curves appropriately
Return new curve IDs
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-01-10. 3 Python tools + C# handlers (CurveOperations.cs) + 19 tests.

userStories.title: Surface from Curves (Loft, Extrude, Revolve)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create surfaces from curves.
acceptanceCriteria: Add loft_curves tool (loft between multiple curves)
Add extrude_curve tool (extrude along vector or path)
Add revolve_curve tool (revolve around axis)
Support closed surfaces where applicable
Return new surface/brep IDs

userStories.title: Dimension Tools
userStories.description: As a user, I want to add dimensions to my model.
acceptanceCriteria: Add create_linear_dimension tool
Add create_angular_dimension tool
Add create_radial_dimension tool
Dimensions update correctly with object changes
Support dimension style parameters

userStories.title: Get/Set Object Properties
userStories.description: As a user, I want to query and modify object properties.
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_object_properties tool (bounding box, area, volume, centroid)
Add set_object_properties tool (name, layer, color, material)
Support batch operations for multiple objects
Return structured property data
